req.title: Update requires title
req.statement: The system shall render 'Title is required.' when POST /<id>/update omits the title.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should render an error message when the title is omitted in a POST request to update a blog post. This behavior needs to be validated through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_update_post_with_title
actions: Send POST request to /<id>/update with title and body
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'Updated Title', 'body': 'Updated Body'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_update_post_without_title
actions: Send POST request to /<id>/update without title
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': '', 'body': 'Updated Body'})
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Title is required.' in r.data

tests.name: test_update_post_with_max_length_title
actions: Send POST request to /<id>/update with max length title
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
